key_decisions.decision: Retains womb-opening image and ownership; male scope becomes explicit in verses 12–15 rather than adding it twice here.
Retains singular son and personal identification with departure; supplies elliptical I do this rather than flattening into past history.
Preserves bodily signs and mouth image without deciding physical versus figurative observance in main text.
Preserves womb-opening and explicit male restriction without collapsing the human redemption distinction that follows.
Keeps substitute species broad as seh, violent alternative explicit, and mandatory human redemption distinct.
Preserves explicit killed, Pharaoh’s agency, sacrifice/redemption contrast and male limitation.
Retains concrete rare totafot object with restrained band rendering and explanatory note; keeps us in concluding reason.
Retains indirect route, Yam Suph and traditional armed sense of hamushim, with uncertain expression noted.
